question: Which of the following is an example of a conjunction?
Fill in the gap: 'I wanted to buy the shoe _____ I had no money.'
Fill in the gap: 'I was very sleepy _____ I went to bed.'
Fill in the gap: 'You can have biscuits _____ you finish your food.'
Fill in the gap: 'We stayed at home _____ it was very hot.'
Fill in the gap: 'Do you want to play football _____ basketball?'
Fill in the gap: 'I like apples _____ bananas.'
Join the two sentences using the correct conjunction: 'I like English. I don't like Maths.'
options: I like English and I don't like Maths.
I like English but I don't like Maths.
I like English or I don't like Maths.
I like English because I don't like Maths.
answer: I like English but I don't like Maths.

question: Join the two sentences using the correct conjunction: 'He fell down. He was running fast.'
options: He fell down or he was running fast.
He fell down but he was running fast.
He fell down because he was running fast.
He fell down if he was running fast.
answer: He fell down because he was running fast.
